scope: Exploratory development comparison on one exposed PS13 participant, both scans; no new independent qualification

old_roi_finding.scope: One baseline scan in the historical PS13 experiment; not an audit of every mask
old_roi_finding.scan: PSBB01 baseline / S3 alias PS50 baseline
old_roi_finding.method: Original PET threshold mask transformed by independently estimated 6-DOF FSL alignment to MRI; nearest-neighbor interpolation, compared with FSL BET brain mask
old_roi_finding.visual_review: Mask is outside the brain on the generated anatomical overlays
old_roi_finding.interpretation: Historical uptake-mask experiment cannot establish anatomical brain kinetic performance; all original outcomes retained
